audit.why: 49.7% over 169 Emerald+ games, difficulty 6/10. Swain owns Level 1 with 750-range Death's Hand against your single turret, you own 3 through 5, and Level 6 flips back to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradicted their own why-text and the packet chart. whys[0] ends 'the window is his' but the chart said Skill; whys[1] says 'neither of you owns it outright' but said Heimerdinger; whys[3] says 'your peak' but said Skill; whys[4] has Demonic Ascension out-healing your turrets and snowballing him but said Skill; whys[5] says 'roughly even' but said Heimerdinger; whys[6] says you must have already ended it but said Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Swain / Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Swain / Skill / Skill, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive mechanic was never stated: Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass, not the outgoing one, so the dodge is stepping out of its path on the way back. dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d ('Get E-rooted') both carried boilerplate with no cooldown and no instruction.
audit.corrected: Nevermove (850 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) sends a wave out and roots only as it returns to Swain, then he can pull rooted champions in. Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s at every rank and its drain lasts indefinitely while he drains a champion, which is why anti-heal timing decides the fight rather than raw MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown across the whole page is Demonic Ascension (120s), but the cooldown that actually gates every trade in lane is Nevermove at 10-12s — a Swain with E down cannot start anything on an immobile target.
audit.corrected: Called out in tldr and dosFull[0].d. Left focus.text on Demonic Ascension since that is the level-6 kill threat and changing the page's focus token is a larger call.

edits.before: Build MR — turret-poke, dodge his E root. Heimerdinger wins the Demonic Ascension cooldown windows.
edits.after: Nevermove only roots on the way back — dodge the return cleanly and Swain has no engage at all.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Swain's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s drain that out-heals your beams after a root — anti-heal by then, and keep a turret wall up.

edits.before: His drain. Poke when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Nevermove (10-12s) is the real cooldown — dodge the return wave.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Nevermove roots on the return, not the way out — sidestep going back.

notes: Demonic Ascension's cooldown is flat 120s at all three ranks in the kit file, so 'engage on its cooldown' advice does not shorten as he levels — worth knowing when planning the level 11 and 16 windows. Vision of Empire (W) is 5500-7500 range and grants Swain a Soul Fragment off any champion it clips, so eating it while sitting in your nest actively feeds his permanent health stacking; that is unmentioned anywhere on the page and is the best remaining addition for a future pass.
